rationale: The X10 flag is for maturity_date before report_date. The current-period investment schedule itself lists Ligado Networks LLC with maturity date 11/1/2023 while the report date is 2025-12-31, so the stored 2023-11-01 maturity is source-backed. The rule is flagging a disclosed matured position for monitoring, not a data error in the maturity_date cell.
